content.text: Skip to main content Game preview Coverage continues Tuesday 6:30 PM ET Preview PRESENTED BY Schedule Tuesday, April 28 7 PM ET Detroit Tigers at Atlanta Braves Tuesday, May 5 8 PM ET L.A. Dodgers at Houston Astros Tuesday, May 12 7 PM ET Detroit Tigers at New York Mets Tuesday, May 19 7 PM ET Toronto Blue Jays at New York Yankees About The 53rd year of baseball on tbs will highlight some of the biggest superstars and most storied rivalries in the league on 24 Tuesday nights throughout the 2026 regular season. It will culminate with exclusive coverage of the 2026 American League Division Series and American League Championship Series in October. This series was filmed in Georgia.
